events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드's dismal start to the season continues as they lose 1–0 at 리즈 유나이티드. They are now ninth in the league, one place below a newly promoted 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 side who have achieved three consecutive league wins.
버밍엄 시티 beat 애스턴 빌라 3–0 at St Andrew's in the first Second City derby in the league for 15 years, and the first in the top flight for 17 years.
After a slow start to the season, the pressure is growing on 선덜랜드 manager 피터 리드. The Daily Mirror tips 조지 그레이엄 to be named as 선덜랜드 manager if Reid is ousted.
Ruud van Nistelrooy scores the winning goal from the penalty spot as 맨체스터 유나이티드 get back on track with a 1–0 home league win over 토트넘 홋스퍼.
피터 리드 gains unexpected support from Sir 보비 롭슨, manager of 선덜랜드's local rivals 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who defends him over the club's recent shortcomings.
A poll among 선덜랜드 supporters names 데이비드 오리어리 as the man they would most like to see as manager in place of under-fire 피터 리드.

September finishes with defending champions 아스널 top of the Premier League, two points ahead of second-placed 리버풀. 맨체스터 유나이티드, held back by two defeats this month, are fourth in the league and level on points with third-placed 미들즈브러 who are mounting a surprise title challenge. 첼시 occupy fifth place, with last month's leaders 토트넘 홋스퍼 now down to sixth. 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 찰턴 애슬레틱 and 사우샘프턴 occupy the bottom three places. 포츠머스 and 레스터 시티 lead the way in Division One, with the playoff zone being occupied by 노리치 시티, 노팅엄 포리스트 , 로더럼 유나이티드 and 셰필드 유나이티드 .
